You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

There’s never a typical day as a Mainframe Storage System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 7+ Years of Experience in Mainframe Storage System Administration.

* Experience with DASD and tape data storage solutions (Experience on DASD/Tape Configuration and Migration) for mainframes.

* Candidate should possess working knowledge of Z/OS Operating System, z/OS(MVS) fundamentals, Storage fundamentals and Storage Devices.

* Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge in the following areas: TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, ISMF, JES2, Catalogs, Datasets (PS/PDS/PDSE/GDG), REXX, SAS, SDSF and Spool.

* Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge & Experience in the following (: MF - Tape & DASD Management) areas: DFSMS, DFSMSHSM, DFSMSDSS, DFSMSDFP, DFSMSRMM, ICF Catalog, VSAM, IDCAMs, CA products (CA Disk, CA allocate and CA-1), FDR products, Omegamon XE or related Storage monitoring tools, ICKDSF, Space abends and SMF/Dcollect/BVIR reports.

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

* Provides technical support activities for a production mainframe environment of multiple LPARs, CECs, DASD and VTS controllers.

* Experience in Storage box data migration (DASD to DASD and Tape to tape) and Storage replication.

* Candidates have to work in customer work hours- US (weekends and holidays as on call staff).

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. title: Technology Specialist - IT Vendor Management
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?

**About the role**

As an ITVMO Demand, Licensing & Compliance professional, you will support enterprise technology demand management, software asset governance, license compliance, and decision intelligence. You will maintain an accurate view of software demand, entitlements, consumption, renewals, and licensing metrics across the technology portfolio.

You will collaborate across business and technology teams to translate complex licensing, usage, compliance, financial, and technology information into clear business insights and actionable recommendations. You will bring a detail-oriented, analytical, customer-service-focused approach while supporting effective governance and continuous improvement.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage enterprise software demand, including intake, validation, prioritization, forecasting, and ongoing tracking. Validate requests against inventory, existing entitlements, approved standards, usage data, and technology roadmaps to recommend appropriate fulfillment paths.
* Interpret software licensing models and conduct effective license position and compliance reviews by reconciling entitlement records, deployment information, user allocations, inventory, usage, and publisher-specific rules to identify underutilization, over-deployment, duplicate capabilities, compliance exposure, and optimization opportunities.
* Track renewals and subscriptions, create demand forecasts, and develop dashboards and management reporting covering demand, fulfillment, utilization, compliance exceptions, renewal readiness, product rationalization, technology spend, budgets, forecasts, allocations, variances, and operational performance.
* Apply AI-enabled analytics and automation to demand forecasting, spend anomaly detection, license optimization, compliance monitoring, renewal readiness, and reporting. Define, develop, test, deploy, and manage AI agents with appropriate human oversight, role-based access, data privacy, model and prompt controls, traceability, accuracy monitoring, exception escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Maintain data quality standards, controls, procedures, decision records, evidence, and audit-ready documentation. Research licensing and technology changes, partner with application owners, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, finance, legal, risk, and other stakeholders, and support software standardization, catalog governance, rationalization, reclamation, reharvesting, and retirement initiatives.

**What you must have to be considered**

* A bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, finance, analytics, or a related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in IT vendor management, software asset management, technology demand management, license compliance, IT governance, or a related function.
* Strong understanding of software licensing models, entitlement records, deployment and usage data, subscriptions, cloud consumption, and infrastructure-related licensing concepts.
* Experience working with software asset management, configuration management, IT service management, inventory, reporting, or business intelligence platforms.
* Ability to analyze large and varied data sets, identify trends and control gaps, reconcile records, and present decision-ready insights.
* Experience with technology spend analytics, budget planning, forecasting, allocation, variance analysis, financial modeling, and executive-level reporting.
* Practical knowledge of AI-enabled analytics, intelligent automation, and the AI-agent lifecycle, including use-case definition, data and workflow design, testing, deployment, governance, monitoring, and adoption.
* Knowledge of audit readiness, evidence management, data governance, policy compliance, risk assessment, and remediation tracking.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical licensing and compliance concepts to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent customer service, critical thinking, decision-making, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
* Embodiment of Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex licensing, technology, financial, and compliance information into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and collaborate effectively across technology and business functions.
* Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation and follow-through.
* A continuous-improvement mindset with an interest in AI-enabled intelligence and automation.
* Effective time management and the ability to manage multiple demand, licensing, compliance, renewal, and reporting priorities.

**Work model**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

Job Summary :


Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.


Role Definition :


Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.


Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction** \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* **Client Access Setup –** Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues.
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible.
* **Issue Resolution** \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption.
* **Escalation** \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level.
* **Documentation** \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team.


Skills :

**Broad Knowledge** \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem\-Solving** \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication** \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability** \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.


Tasks :

**Responding to Cases** \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics** \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions** \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues** \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario** \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

* Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs.
* Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity.
* Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly.
* Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation.


Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
* 0\-1 year of experience (Experience preferred)
* Key Skills:
	+ Ms. Excel (Intermediate)

* Problem Solving (Intermediate)
* Analytical skills (Basic)
* Active Listening, Understanding \& Empathy (Advanced)
* Email Writing skills (Intermediate)
* Fundamental understanding of the Customer Support process and techniques
* Proficient in the English language
* Basic understanding of the customer environment and NIQ tools in use
* Exchanges straightforward information
* Technically/digitally savvy

* Volunteer time off

title: Material Data Management System Administrator
description:
**Position Overview**


Ascend Performance Materials is seeking a Material Data Management System Administrator to support the configuration, data expansion, and ongoing improvement of our web\-based material data management system.


This role requires a blend of technical data handling skills and a strong background in understanding material properties, technical datasheets, testing standards, and engineering documentation. You will focus on preparing the system to receive structured material, product, and technical data using tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, and platform\-native upload features.

**Targeted Outcomes**

* Support the successful expansion and ongoing maintenance of Ascend's web\-based material data management system.
* Develop repeatable processes for preparing, formatting, validating, and uploading material and product data into the system.
* Enable efficient mass uploads of technical data from Excel, Word, PDF, and legacy source files.
* Support technical engineers and business users by improving workflows, reporting, and access to accurate material data

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Configuration \& Administration:**

* Configure and maintain the web\-based material data management platform, including user workflows, templates, forms, user roles, and system settings.
* Format and structure system fields to store material, product, and technical data in a consistent and searchable format.
* Configure low\-code/no\-code features including forms, approval routing, data views, and reporting tools.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, coordinate with engineering or software vendors, and track issues through resolution

**Data Formatting, Migration \& Mass Uploads:**

* Utilize SQL, Python, Excel, and platform\-native tools for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Extract unstructured or semi\-structured data from Word, PDF, and Excel documents into database\-ready formats.
* Perform mass uploads of product data, technical datasheets, property tables, document links, and related literature.
* Audit legacy systems to resolve missing, duplicated, inconsistent, or improperly formatted entries.

**Material Data \& Cross\-Functional Support:**

* Work closely with technical engineering and product teams to translate data requirements into structured fields and reports.
* Maintain revision control, data traceability, and controlled\-document practices across product data.
* Build reporting dashboards and analytics using Excel, Power BI, SQL, or native platform reporting tools.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Management, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Data Management:** Proven experience working with structured data formatting, data transformation, migration, and mass upload processes.
* **Document Extraction:** Demonstrated experience extracting and preparing data from Excel, Word, PDF, and technical documents.
* **Technical Skills:** Working knowledge of **SQL**, **Python**, Excel, Power BI, and database concepts.
* **System Support:** Experience supporting web\-based enterprise applications, technical data systems, or document management platforms, including low\-code/no\-code configurations.
* **Vendor \& User Support:** Background working with software vendors or technical support teams to resolve application bugs and system issues.
* **Domain Exposure (Preferred):** Familiarity with material properties, product datasheets, testing standards, or engineering documentation is a strong plus
**At Ascend Performance Materials, we value transparency and fairness in our hiring process. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters, search firms, or staffing agencies. Any resumes received from such entities will be considered the property of Ascend Performance Materials, and we will not be obligated to pay any fees for such submissions. Our Talent Acquisition Team actively engages with preferred recruitment partners who have established agreements with us. We encourage all interested candidates to apply directly through our official channels to be considered for any open positions.**

**About Us:**

  

Ascend Performance Materials is the premium provider of high\-quality chemicals, fibers and plastics focused on improving quality of life and inspiring a better tomorrow through innovation. We are a fully integrated material solutions provider with manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe and Asia.

  

Our global workforce makes the materials used to make safer vehicles, cleaner energy, better medical devices, smarter appliances, and longer\-lasting apparel and consumer goods. We are committed to safety, sustainability, and the success of our customers and our communities.

 **Why work at Ascend?**

  

Our vision is to be the recognized leader in the nylon 6,6 value chain, creating new possibilities with PA66 for everyone, everywhere, every day. We achieve that through living our Ascend values: OARS.

  

Our OARS values shape how we work, lead, and grow together. We take **ownership**, stay **accountable**, operate **reliably**, and **support** one another to deliver results safely and consistently. Through clear expectations, empowered decision\-making, intentional communication, and continuous feedback, we create a culture built on action, visibility, and shared success.

  

Together, OARS gives us a shared language and clear direction. These values guide our decisions, shape priorities and set expectations as we move forward – aligned, focused and committed to creating performance materials that improve lives today and inspire a better tomorrow.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, citizenship, genetic information or other protected status under federal, state or local laws.

title: Principal IT Pillar Specialist - ISM (Information system Manager)
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Principal IT Pillar Specialist is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex IT Pillar\-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. They may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and are regarded as a specialist in the field of IT Pillar. As such, they must have in\-depth expertise in the IT Pillar as well as broad knowledge of the IT Pillar discipline within the Information Technology function.


  
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  

  

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.
  
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for entire life cycle information management process of projects, from initial estimate to final completions and handover.
* Review of Invitation to Bid (ITT) from Clients for the Information Management requirements and assessment of the risks \& opportunities in this area
* Co\-ordinate with Business and IT stakeholders in the preparation of the Information \& Systems Management Execution Plan for proposals and projects
* Prepare Information \& Systems Management estimates covering hardware, resources and licenses and control spending within the allocated budgets
* Prepare and review of proposal write\-ups
* Coordinate the project specific infrastructure setup for construction sites, client resident teams and joint venture partners in cooperation with Engineering IT and Project IT.
* Specify and coordinate the processes and tools for data collection, validation consolidation and handover to the Client.
* Single point of contact to project management and to the Client for all aspects related to Information Management and supporting systems.
* Translate project specific information requirements into efficient system configurations and related user instructions in conjunction with execution tool administrators.
* Prepare functional specification and manage the development and implementation of project specific applications and/or interfaces
* Detect and manage project scope changes
* Capture lessons learned, best practices and ensure their embedding in the organization.
* Initiate and conducting Information Systems Management (ISM) audits and peer reviews
Provide input to audits and peer reviews, undertake other project audits as required.  
* 

**Required Key Project Execution Knowledge and/or Concepts Requirements:**

* Planning \& Progress Measurement
* Concepts of Project Budget and Cost Control
* Engineering
  

	+ Design Software Tools
	+ Data Management Standards
	+ CHIFOS (JIP 36\)
	+ ISO 15926
	+ ISO 14224
	+ PODS
	+ Analysis and Calculation Tools
	+ Pipeline and GIS Tools
	+ Vendor / Supplier Data / Documentation
	+ Deliverables
* Document Management Systems and Concepts
* SCM
  

	+ Engineering – MTO / MR – SCM Interface
	+ Technical Bid Evaluation Process
	+ PO Process
	+ Expediting Process including TPI Inspection and Material Test Certificates
	+ Logistics Process
	+ Warehousing and Material Preservation Process
* Fabrication / Construction
  

	+ Spooling Process and Tools
	+ Steel Structures Fabrication Drawing Generation
	+ Advanced Work Packaging Process and Tools
	+ Fabrication / Construction Work Measurement Tools
	+ Concepts of Flange Management
	+ Hot Tapping
	+ Pigging
* Quality Control
  

	+ Material Test Certificates
	+ Third Party Inspections at Manufacturer’s Location
	+ Welding Non\-Destructive Testing
	+ Hydrotesting
* Commissioning
  

	+ System Sub\-System Definitions
	+ Status Index
	+ Inspection Test Reports (ITR)
	+ Punch Management
	+ Project Technical Assurance
	+ Completions Certification
* Client Handover Packaging
  

	+ Data
	+ Documentation

  
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience in IT supporting EPCI business applications as a lead or administrator.
* Extensive functional knowledge in the Payroll industry and leadership expertise.
* Extensive Project Management experience.
* Ability to work as a team member as well as act as a team leader.
* Have wide experience with technical tools such as ERP, BI, etc.
* Maintain key competencies associated with the IT function.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
* Must be a finance IT SME in process \& technical knowledge of Timekeeping systems, General Accounting, Job Cost Accounting, Sub\-ledgers, General Ledger, and Close Cycles (month, quarter year).
* Knowledge of Tax, Treasury, Audit, Financial Reporting, Project Accounting, Billing \& Revenue is a plus.
